table inet filter {
	set lan_ports {
		type inet_service
		flags interval
		elements = { 22, 8000-8100 }
	}

	chain inbound_ipv4 {
		icmp type echo-request limit rate 5/second burst 5 packets accept
	}

	chain inbound_ipv6 {
		icmpv6 type { nd-router-advert, nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert } accept
		icmpv6 type echo-request limit rate 5/second burst 5 packets accept
	}

	chain inbound {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state vmap { invalid : drop, established : accept, related : accept }
		iifname "lo" accept
		meta protocol vmap { ip : jump inbound_ipv4, ip6 : jump inbound_ipv6 }
		tcp dport @lan_ports accept
		udp dport 50000-50999 ip saddr 172.16.0.0/12 accept
		tcp dport { 22, 80, 443 } accept
	}
}
